### Load data

```{r load-data, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(rlang)
library(cbbplotR)


unc_t <- readr::read_csv("unc-t.csv")

unc_final <- readr::read_csv("unc_final.csv")

# save function 
gt_save_crop <- function(data, file = NULL, bg = "white", whitespace = 50, zoom = 2, expand = 5) {
  tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
  
  # Wrap the gtsave_extra call in a tryCatch to handle errors
  tryCatch({
    gtExtras::gtsave_extra(data, tmp, zoom = zoom, expand = expand)
  }, error = function(e) {
    # If there's an error, try using regular gt::gtsave instead
    message("gtsave_extra failed, trying gt::gtsave...")
    gt::gtsave(data, tmp, zoom = zoom, expand = expand)
  })
  
  magick::image_read(tmp) |> 
    magick::image_trim() |> 
    magick::image_border(bg, glue::glue('{whitespace}x{whitespace}')) |> 
    magick::image_write(file)
  unlink(tmp)
}

```

### NCAA Tournament gt

```{r unc-gt, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

unc_t <- readr::read_csv("unc-t.csv", col_types = readr::cols(.default = "c")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(record = as.character(record))

round_cols <- c("R64", "R32", "S16", "E8", "F4", "F2", "C")

# Pre-process: build merged year/record column
unc_t <- unc_t |>
  dplyr::mutate(
      record = stringr::str_remove_all(record, '"'),
    year_display = glue::glue(
      "<div style='font-weight:bold; font-size:14px;'>{year}</div>
       <div style='font-weight:bold; font-size:11px; color:#333333;'>{record}</div>"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(-record) |>
  dplyr::mutate(seed = dplyr::if_else(seed == "X", "", seed))

tbl <- unc_t |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::fmt_markdown(columns = c(miss, year_display, tidyselect::all_of(round_cols)))

for (col in round_cols) {
  tbl <- tbl |>
    gt::text_transform(
      locations = gt::cells_body(columns = tidyselect::all_of(col)),
      fn = function(x) {
        purrr::map_chr(x, function(val) {
          if (grepl(">NA<", val, fixed = TRUE) || grepl("^\\s*$", val)) {
            ""
          } else if (grepl(">0<", val, fixed = TRUE)) {
            "<span style='display:inline-block; width:20px; height:20px; background-color:#f5c6cb; border-radius:2px; opacity:0.6;'>&nbsp;</span>"
          } else if (grepl(">1<", val, fixed = TRUE)) {
            "<span style='display:inline-block; width:20px; height:20px; background-color:#56a0d3; border-radius:2px;'>&nbsp;</span>"
          } else {
            val
          }
        })
      }
    )
}

unc_header <- glue::glue(
  "<div style='display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;'>
      <div>
       <img src='https://a.espncdn.com/combiner/i?img=/redesign/assets/img/icons/ESPN-icon-basketball.png'

       <span style='display: block; font-weight: bold; text-align: center; font-size: 24px;'>Carolina's NCAA Tournament finishes since 1998</span>
       <span style='font-size: 13px; font-weight: normal; display: block; text-align: center; color: #444;'>
         Round-by-round results for every season since 1998, including three national titles.
       </span>
       <span style='font-size: 11px; font-weight: normal; display: block; text-align: center; color: #666; margin-top: 4px;'>
         <span style='display:inline-block; width:12px; height:12px; background-color:#56a0d3; border-radius:2px; vertical-align:middle;'>&nbsp;</span> Advanced &nbsp;&nbsp;
         <span style='display:inline-block; width:12px; height:12px; background-color:#f5c6cb; border-radius:2px; opacity:0.8; vertical-align:middle;'>&nbsp;</span> Eliminated &nbsp;&nbsp;
         Logo indicates round reached
       </span>
     </div>
     <div>
       <img src='https://a.espncdn.com/combiner/i?img=/i/teamlogos/ncaa/500/153.png'
       style='height: 40px; width: auto; vertical-align: middle;'>

   </div>
  <div style='border-top: 2px solid black; margin-top: 10px; width: 100%;'></div>"
)

tbl <- tbl |>
  # Special highlight for C column (gold background for champion)
  gt::text_transform(
    locations = gt::cells_body(columns = C),
    fn = function(x) {
      purrr::map_chr(x, function(val) {
        if (grepl("<img", val, fixed = TRUE)) {

             border-radius:4px; padding:3px 4px; vertical-align:middle;'>{val}</span>"
          )
        } else {
          val
        }
      })
    }
  ) |>
  # Special highlight for F2 column (silver background for runner-up)
  gt::text_transform(
    locations = gt::cells_body(columns = F2),
    fn = function(x) {
      purrr::map_chr(x, function(val) {
        if (grepl("<img", val, fixed = TRUE)) {
          glue::glue(
            "<span style='display:inline-block; background:#C0C0C0; border:2px solid #A8A8A8;
             border-radius:4px; padding:3px 4px; vertical-align:middle;'>{val}</span>"
          )
        } else {
          val
        }
      })
    }
  ) |>
  gt::cols_hide(year) |>
  gtExtras::gt_theme_dot_matrix() |>
  gt::sub_missing(missing_text = "") |>
  gt::cols_align(align = "center", columns = c(seed, tidyselect::all_of(round_cols))) |>

  gt::cols_move(columns = year_display, after = miss) |>

    label = "",

  ) |>
  # Tournament round spanner
  gt::tab_spanner(

  ) |>
  gt::cols_label(
    miss         = gt::html("<b>&#128078;</b>"),

    seed         = gt::html("<b>Seed</b>"),
    R64          = gt::html("<b>R64</b>"),
    R32          = gt::html("<b>R32</b>"),
    S16          = gt::html("<b>S16</b>"),
    E8           = gt::html("<b>E8</b>"),
    F4           = gt::html("<b>F4</b>"),
    F2           = gt::html("<b>F2</b>"),

  ) |>

  ) |>
  gt::cols_align(columns = gt::everything(), align = "center") |>
  # Column widths
  gt::cols_width(
    miss         ~ gt::px(40),
    year_display ~ gt::px(80),
    seed         ~ gt::px(50),
    R64          ~ gt::px(40),
    R32          ~ gt::px(40),
    S16          ~ gt::px(40),
    E8           ~ gt::px(40),
    F4           ~ gt::px(40),
    F2           ~ gt::px(40),
    C            ~ gt::px(40)
  ) |>
  # Seed column color scale
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_fill(color = "#d6eaf8"),
    locations = gt::cells_body(
      columns = seed,
      rows = !is.na(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(seed))) & suppressWarnings(as.numeric(seed)) >= 13
    )
  ) |>
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_fill(color = "#d3e6f3"),
    locations = gt::cells_body(
      columns = seed,
      rows = !is.na(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(seed))) & suppressWarnings(as.numeric(seed)) %in% 9:12
    )
  ) |>

    style = gt::cell_fill(color = "#a4cce7"),
    locations = gt::cells_body(
      columns = seed,
      rows = !is.na(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(seed))) & suppressWarnings(as.numeric(seed)) %in% 5:8
    )
  ) |>
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_fill(color = "#85badf"),
    locations = gt::cells_body(
      columns = seed,
      rows = !is.na(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(seed))) & suppressWarnings(as.numeric(seed)) %in% 1:4
    )
  ) |>
  # Hide empty spanner visually
  gt::tab_style(
    style = list(
      gt::cell_fill(color = "transparent"),
      gt::cell_borders(
        sides = c("top", "bottom", "left", "right"),
        color = "transparent",
        weight = gt::px(0)
      )
    ),
    locations = gt::cells_column_spanners(spanners = "empty_spanner")
  ) |>
  # Horizontal row borders
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_borders(sides = "bottom", color = "#dddddd", weight = gt::px(1)),
    locations = gt::cells_body(rows = gt::everything())
  ) |>
  # Vertical column borders on all body cells
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_borders(sides = "left", color = "#dddddd", weight = gt::px(1)),

  ) |>

    style = gt::cell_borders(sides = "left", color = "#dddddd", weight = gt::px(1)),
```

### Bracket gt

```{r bracket-gt, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}


url <- "http://www.bracketmatrix.com/"

page <- rvest::read_html(url)

raw_table <- page |>
  rvest::html_element("table") |>
  rvest::html_table(fill = TRUE)

bracket <- raw_table |>
  dplyr::slice(4:dplyr::n()) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(X1)) |>
  dplyr::select(
    seed = X1, team = X2, conf = X3
  ) |>
  dplyr::add_row(seed = 11, team = "San Diego State", conf = "Mountain West") |>
  dplyr::add_row(seed = 11, team = "Auburn", conf = "SEC") |>
  dplyr::add_row(seed = 11, team = "Oklahoma", conf = "SEC") |>
  dplyr::add_row(seed = 11, team = "Indiana", conf = "Big Ten") |>
  dplyr::add_row(seed = 11, team = "New Mexico", conf = "Mountain West") |>
  dplyr::add_row(seed = 11, team = "Stanford", conf = "ACC")


# Normalize team names -----------------------------------------------------

name_fixes <- c(
  "Michigan State"       = "Michigan St.",
  "Iowa State"           = "Iowa St.",
  "St. Mary's (CA)"      = "Saint Mary's",
  "Miami (FLA.)"         = "Miami FL",
  "Utah State"           = "Utah St.",
  "Ohio State"           = "Ohio St.",
  "Central Florida"      = "UCF",
  "North Carolina State" = "North Carolina St.",
  "Long Island"          = "LIU Brooklyn",
  "Miami (Ohio)"         = "Miami OH",
  "North Dakota State"   = "North Dakota St.",
  "Portland State"       = "Portland St.",
  "Wright State"         = "Wright St.",
  "Tennessee State"      = "Tennessee St.",
  "Bethune-Cookman"      = "Bethune Cookman",
  "San Diego State"      = "San Diego St.",
  "McNeese State"        = "McNeese St.",
  "Sam Houston State"    = "Sam Houston St.",
  "California Baptist"   = "Cal Baptist",
  "Morgan State"         = "Morgan St.",
  "Grambling"            = "Grambling St.",
  "Norfolk State"        = "Norfolk St.",
  "NC-Wilmington"        = "UNC Wilmington",
  "E. Tennessee State"   = "East Tennessee St.",
  "Montana State"        = "Montana St.",
  "Kennesaw State"       = "Kennesaw St."
)

# Still alive (Round of 32) ------------------------------------------------

still_alive <- c(
 "Michigan", "Michigan St.", "Duke",
"Houston", "Texas", "Illinois", "Nebraska", "Arkansas",  "Purdue", "Iowa St.", "St. John's", "Tennessee", 
  "Iowa", "Arizona","Connecticut", "Alabama"
)

# Region assignments -------------------------------------------------------

east <- c("Duke", "Siena", "Ohio St.",
          "TCU", "St. John's",
          "Northern Iowa", "Kansas", "Cal Baptist",
          "Louisville", "South Florida", "Michigan St.",
          "North Dakota St.", "UCLA", "UCF",
          "Connecticut", "Furman")

south <- c("Florida", "Prairie View A&M", "Lehigh",
           "Clemson", "Iowa", "Vanderbilt", "McNeese St.",
           "Nebraska", "Troy", "North Carolina", "VCU",
           "Illinois", "Pennsylvania", "Saint Mary's", "Texas A&M",
           "Houston", "Idaho")

west <- c("Arizona", "LIU Brooklyn", "Villanova", "Utah St.",
          "Wisconsin", "High Point", "Arkansas", "Hawaii",
          "BYU", "Texas", "North Carolina St.", "Gonzaga", "Kennesaw St.",
          "Miami FL", "Missouri", "Purdue", "Queens")

midwest <- c("Michigan", "UMBC", "Howard", "Georgia", "Saint Louis",
             "Texas Tech", "Akron", "Alabama", "Hofstra",
             "Tennessee", "Miami OH", "SMU", "Virginia",
             "Wright St.", "Kentucky", "Santa Clara", "Iowa St.",
             "Tennessee St.")


# Build bracket_long -------------------------------------------------------

bracket_long <- bracket |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    team      = dplyr::recode(team, !!!name_fixes),
    team_sort = team,
    seed      = as.integer(seed),
    region = dplyr::case_when(
      team %in% east    ~ "East",
      team %in% south   ~ "South",
      team %in% west    ~ "West",
      team %in% midwest ~ "Midwest",
      TRUE              ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(region)) |>
  cbbplotR::gt_cbb_teams(team, team, include_name = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    team_html = dplyr::if_else(
      team_sort %in% still_alive,
      glue::glue(
        "<span style='display:inline-block; border:1px solid transparent;
         border-radius:4px; padding:1px 3px; vertical-align:middle;'>{team}</span>"
      ),
      glue::glue(
        "<span style='display:inline-block; opacity:0.25; border:1px solid transparent;
         border-radius:4px; padding:1px 3px; vertical-align:middle;'>{team}</span>"
      )
    )
  )


# Summarise by seed --------------------------------------------------------

bracket_summary <- bracket_long |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    region_f  = factor(region, levels = c("East", "South", "West", "Midwest")),
    team_sort = dplyr::case_when(         # override sort key here, after region_f exists
      team_sort == "Texas"              ~ "AAA_Texas",
      team_sort == "North Carolina St." ~ "AAA_ZNorth Carolina St.",
      TRUE                              ~ team_sort
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(seed, region_f, team_sort) |>
  dplyr::group_by(seed) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    teams = paste(team_html, collapse = " "),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# Build gt table -----------------------------------------------------------

custom_header <- glue::glue(
  "<div style='display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;'>
    <div>
      <img src='https://a.espncdn.com/combiner/i?img=/redesign/assets/img/icons/ESPN-icon-basketball.png'
        style='height: 45px; width: auto; vertical-align: middle;'>
    </div>
    <div style='flex-grow:1; margin-left: 30px; margin-right: 30px'>
      <span style='display: block; font-weight: bold; text-align: center; font-size: 24px;'>
        2026 NCAA Tournament Sweet 16 by Seed
      </span>
      <span style='font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; display: block; text-align: center;'>
        Teams are grouped by <b>region and seed line</b>.<br>
      </span>
    </div>
    <div>
      <img src='https://a.espncdn.com/combiner/i?img=/redesign/assets/img/icons/ESPN-icon-basketball.png'
        style='height: 45px; width: auto; vertical-align: middle;'>
    </div>
  </div><br>"
)

bracket_tbl <- bracket_summary |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gtUtils::gt_theme_savant() |>
  gt::fmt_markdown(columns = teams) |>
  gt::cols_label(
    seed  = "Seed",
    teams = "Teams"
  ) |>
  gt::tab_header(title = gt::html(custom_header)) |>
  gt::tab_source_note(gt::html(
    "<hr>
     data via ncaa.com
     <hr>
     Faded teams were eliminated in the First or Second Rounds
     <hr>
     March 23, 2026 | Table by Chris at Bless your Chart"
  )) |>
  gt::tab_options(
    table.font.size            = gt::px(14),
    heading.align              = "left",
    column_labels.font.weight  = "bold"
  ) |>
  gt::tab_style(
    style = list(gt::cell_borders(
      sides  = c("left", "right", "top", "bottom"),
      color  = "black",
      weight = gt::px(2)
    )),
    locations = list(
      gt::cells_body(),
      gt::cells_column_labels()
    )
  ) |>
  gt::tab_options(table.width = gt::px(575))


gt_save_crop(
  bracket_tbl,
  file       = "bracket_tbl.png",
  whitespace = 60,
  bg         = "white"
)

bracket_tbl
```

### Radars 

```{r radar-plot, warning=FALSE, message=TRUE}

tournament_rounds <- tibble::tibble(
  Season = factor(2017:2026, levels = 2017:2026),
  Round  = c("Champions", "R32", "S16", "Missed", "R64",
             "Runner-up", "Missed", "S16", "R64", "R64")
)

radar_vars <- c(
  "RankeFG_Pct", "RankTO_Pct", "RankOR_Pct", "RankFT_Rate",
  "RankDeFG_Pct", "RankDTO_Pct", "RankDOR_Pct", "RankDFT_Rate"
)

spoke_short <- c(
  RankeFG_Pct  = "eFG%",
  RankTO_Pct   = "TO%",
  RankOR_Pct   = "OR%",
  RankFT_Rate  = "FTR",
  RankDeFG_Pct = "DeFG%",
  RankDTO_Pct  = "DTO%",
  RankDOR_Pct  = "DOR%",
  RankDFT_Rate = "DFTR"
)

field_size <- tibble::tibble(
  Season  = factor(2017:2026, levels = 2017:2026),
  n_teams = c(351, 351, 353, 353, 357, 358, 363, 362, 364, 365)
)

unc_radar_raw <- unc_final |>
  dplyr::mutate(Season = factor(Season, levels = 2017:2026)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Coach = dplyr::if_else(Coach == "Roy Williams", "Roy Williams | .685 (120-55)",
                           "Hubert Davis | .698 (125-54)")
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(field_size, by = "Season") |>
  dplyr::left_join(tournament_rounds, by = "Season") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    seed_label = dplyr::if_else(Seed == 0, "X", as.character(Seed)),
    facet_label = paste0(
  "<b>", Season, " (", Wins, "-", Losses, ") | ", Round, " | Seed: ", seed_label, "</b><br>",
  "AdjEM: ", round(AdjEM, 1), " (#", RankAdjEM, ") <br>",
  "AdjT: #", RankAdjTempo, " (", round(AdjTempo, 1), ")"
),
    Coach = factor(Coach, levels = c("Roy Williams | .685 (120-55)", "Hubert Davis | .698 (125-54)"))
  )

raw_ranks_long <- unc_radar_raw |>
  dplyr::select(Season, Coach, facet_label, dplyr::all_of(radar_vars)) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols      = dplyr::all_of(radar_vars),
    names_to  = "metric",
    values_to = "raw_rank"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(metric = factor(metric, levels = radar_vars))

unc_radar <- unc_radar_raw |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::all_of(radar_vars),
      ~ (n_teams + 1 - .x) / n_teams
    )
  )

season_labels <- unc_radar |>
  dplyr::distinct(Season, facet_label) |>
  dplyr::arrange(Season) |>
  tibble::deframe()

radar_long <- unc_radar |>
  dplyr::select(Season, Coach, facet_label, dplyr::all_of(radar_vars)) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols      = dplyr::all_of(radar_vars),
    names_to  = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(metric = factor(metric, levels = radar_vars))

n_metrics <- length(radar_vars)

radar_coords <- radar_long |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    angle = (as.integer(metric) - 1) * 2 * pi / n_metrics - pi / 2,
    x     = value * cos(angle),
    y     = value * sin(angle)
  )

radar_closed <- radar_coords |>
  dplyr::group_by(Season, Coach, facet_label) |>
  dplyr::group_modify(~ dplyr::bind_rows(.x, dplyr::slice(.x, 1))) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

spoke_labels <- radar_long |>
  dplyr::distinct(Season, Coach, facet_label, metric) |>
  dplyr::left_join(raw_ranks_long, by = c("Season", "Coach", "facet_label", "metric")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    angle = (as.integer(metric) - 1) * 2 * pi / n_metrics - pi / 2,
    x     = 1.28 * cos(angle),
    y     = 1.28 * sin(angle),
    label = paste0(spoke_short[as.character(metric)], "\n#", raw_rank)
  )

grid_rings <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  r     = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0),
  theta = seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 200)
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(x = r * cos(theta), y = r * sin(theta))

season_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
  ggplot2::geom_path(
    data = grid_rings,
    ggplot2::aes(x, y, group = r),
    colour = "grey80", linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_segment(
    data = spoke_labels,
    ggplot2::aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = cos(angle), yend = sin(angle)),
    colour = "grey75", linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_polygon(
    data = radar_closed,
    ggplot2::aes(x, y, group = Season),
    fill = "#7BAFD4", alpha = 0.35, colour = "#005B99", linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    data = radar_coords,
    ggplot2::aes(x, y),
    colour = "#005B99", size = 1.4
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(
    data = spoke_labels,
    ggplot2::aes(x, y, label = label),
    size       = 2.2,
    hjust      = "outward",
    vjust      = "outward",
    lineheight = 0.9,
    family     = "Roboto Condensed"
  ) +
  ggh4x::facet_nested_wrap(
    ~ Coach + Season,
    nrow      = 2,
    nest_line = TRUE,
    strip     = ggh4x::strip_nested(
      text_x = list(
        ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 9, colour = "white", family = "Roboto Condensed"),
        ggtext::element_markdown(size = 7, lineheight = 1.3, colour = "grey20", family = "Roboto Condensed")
      ),
      background_x = list(
        ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "#7BAFD4", colour = "#005B99"),
        ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "grey96", colour = "grey80")
      ),
      by_layer_x = TRUE
    ),
    labeller = ggplot2::labeller(Season = season_labels)
  ) +
  ggplot2::coord_fixed(
    xlim = c(-1.6, 1.6),
    ylim = c(-1.6, 1.6),
    clip = "off"
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title   = "This is Carolina Basketball . . . over the last 10 seasons",
    subtitle = "Each spoke is a national rank for the four factors and <b>further from center is better</b>.<br> Four factors are the building blocks on efficiency measured on offense and defense: eFG% (shooting), TO% (turnovers), DR/OR% (rebounds), and FTR (Free Throw Rate).",
    caption = "data via kenpom.com through March 22, 2026 games | Viz by Chris at Bless your chart"
  ) +
  hrbrthemes::theme_ipsum(
    grid        = FALSE,
    axis        = FALSE,
    ticks       = FALSE,
    base_family = "Roboto Condensed",
    plot_margin = ggplot2::margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    plot.title    = ggtext::element_markdown(face = "bold", size = 14, family = "Roboto Condensed"),
    plot.subtitle = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 10, colour = "grey40", family = "Roboto Condensed"),
    plot.caption  = ggplot2::element_text(size = 8, colour = "grey50", family = "Roboto Condensed", face = "plain"),
    axis.text.x   = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.text.y   = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.title.x  = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.title.y  = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.spacing = ggplot2::unit(1.2, "lines")
  )


ggplot2::ggsave(
  "unc_ff_season_plot.png",
  season_plot,
  h = 7,
  w = 10,
  dpi = 600,
  type = 'cairo',
  bg = "white"
)

### individual radar 

stat_vars <- c(
  "eFG_Pct", "TO_Pct", "OR_Pct", "FT_Rate",
  "DeFG_Pct", "DTO_Pct", "DOR_Pct", "DFT_Rate"
)

eff_vars <- c("AdjEM", "RankAdjEM", "AdjOE", "RankAdjOE", "AdjDE", "RankAdjDE")

coach_median_ranks <- unc_radar_raw |>
  dplyr::group_by(Coach) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(radar_vars), ~ round(median(.x))),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols      = dplyr::all_of(radar_vars),
    names_to  = "metric",
    values_to = "median_rank"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(metric = factor(metric, levels = radar_vars))

coach_median_stats <- unc_final |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Coach = dplyr::if_else(Coach == "Roy Williams", "Roy Williams | .685 (120-55)",
                           "Hubert Davis | .698 (125-54)"),
    Coach = factor(Coach, levels = c("Roy Williams | .685 (120-55)", "Hubert Davis | .698 (125-54)"))
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(Coach) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(stat_vars), ~ round(median(.x), 1)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols      = dplyr::all_of(stat_vars),
    names_to  = "stat",
    values_to = "median_stat"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    metric = factor(
      dplyr::case_match(
        stat,
        "eFG_Pct"  ~ "RankeFG_Pct",
        "TO_Pct"   ~ "RankTO_Pct",
        "OR_Pct"   ~ "RankOR_Pct",
        "FT_Rate"  ~ "RankFT_Rate",
        "DeFG_Pct" ~ "RankDeFG_Pct",
        "DTO_Pct"  ~ "RankDTO_Pct",
        "DOR_Pct"  ~ "RankDOR_Pct",
        "DFT_Rate" ~ "RankDFT_Rate"
      ),
      levels = radar_vars
    )
  )

coach_eff <- unc_radar_raw |>
  dplyr::group_by(Coach) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(eff_vars), ~ round(median(.x), 1)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    eff_label = paste0(
      "AdjEM: ", AdjEM, " (#", RankAdjEM, ") | ",
      "AdjO: ", AdjOE, " (#", RankAdjOE, ")  | ",
      "AdjD: ", AdjDE, " (#", RankAdjDE, ")"
    ),
    Coach = factor(Coach, levels = c("Roy Williams | .685 (120-55)", "Hubert Davis | .698 (125-54)"))
  )

coach_field <- field_size |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Coach = dplyr::if_else(
      as.integer(as.character(Season)) <= 2021,
      "Roy Williams | .685 (120-55)",
      "Hubert Davis | .698 (125-54)"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(Coach) |>
  dplyr::summarise(n_teams = round(median(n_teams)), .groups = "drop")

coach_normalized <- unc_radar_raw |>
  dplyr::group_by(Coach) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(radar_vars), ~ round(median(.x))),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(coach_field, by = "Coach") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::all_of(radar_vars),
      ~ (n_teams + 1 - .x) / n_teams
    ),
    Coach = factor(Coach, levels = c("Roy Williams | .685 (120-55)", "Hubert Davis | .698 (125-54)"))
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    coach_eff |> dplyr::select(Coach, eff_label),
    by = "Coach"
  )

coach_labels <- coach_normalized |>
  dplyr::distinct(Coach, eff_label) |>
  dplyr::arrange(Coach) |>
  tibble::deframe()

coach_long <- coach_normalized |>
  dplyr::select(Coach, eff_label, dplyr::all_of(radar_vars)) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols      = dplyr::all_of(radar_vars),
    names_to  = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    metric = factor(metric, levels = radar_vars),
    angle  = (as.integer(metric) - 1) * 2 * pi / n_metrics - pi / 2,
    x      = value * cos(angle),
    y      = value * sin(angle)
  )

coach_closed <- coach_long |>
  dplyr::group_by(Coach, eff_label) |>
  dplyr::group_modify(~ dplyr::bind_rows(.x, dplyr::slice(.x, 1))) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

coach_spoke_labels <- coach_long |>
  dplyr::distinct(Coach, eff_label, metric, angle) |>
  dplyr::left_join(coach_median_ranks, by = c("Coach", "metric")) |>
  dplyr::left_join(coach_median_stats, by = c("Coach", "metric")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    x     = 1.28 * cos(angle),
    y     = 1.28 * sin(angle),
    label = paste0(
      spoke_short[as.character(metric)], "\n",
      median_stat, "\n",
      "(#", median_rank, ")"
    )
  )

comp_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
  ggplot2::geom_path(
    data = grid_rings,
    ggplot2::aes(x, y, group = r),
    colour = "grey80", linewidth = 0.4
  ) +

  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(

  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(

  ) +
  ggh4x::facet_nested_wrap(
```

### SRS 

```{r srs-plot, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

df <- readr::read_csv("all_teams_srs.csv") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Team   = team_name,
    year   = as.integer(stringr::str_sub(Season, 1, 4)),
    is_unc = Team == "North Carolina"
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(year >= 1960) |>
  dplyr::group_by(year) |>
  dplyr::mutate(SRS = ((SRS - mean(SRS, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(SRS, na.rm = TRUE)) * 7.5 + 9) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::arrange(Team, year) |>
  dplyr::group_by(Team) |>
  dplyr::mutate(srs_roll = zoo::rollmean(
    SRS,
    k = 4,
    fill = NA,
    align = "right"
  )) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

gray_teams <- dplyr::filter(df, !is_unc)
unc        <- dplyr::filter(df, is_unc)

unc_label <- unc |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(srs_roll)) |>
  dplyr::slice_tail(n = 1)

eras <- tibble::tibble(
  year  = c(1962, 1997, 2003, 2021),
  end   = c(1996, 2002, 2020, 2025),
  label = c(
    "Dean Smith",
    "Bill Guthridge /\nMatt Doherty",
    "Roy Williams",
    "Hubert Davis"
  )
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(label_x = dplyr::case_when(
    label %in% c("Dean Smith", "Roy Williams") ~ (year + end) / 2,
    TRUE                                        ~ as.double(year) + 0.4
  ))

eras_centered <- dplyr::filter(eras, label %in% c("Dean Smith", "Roy Williams"))
eras_left     <- dplyr::filter(eras, !label %in% c("Dean Smith", "Roy Williams"))

srs_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(

  ggplot2::geom_text(

  ggplot2::geom_text(

    lineheight = 0.85

  ) +

  ) +

  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(

  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(

  ) +
  ggplot2::annotate(

    oob    = scales::squish
  ) +
  ggplot2::annotate(
    cfbplotR::GeomCFBlogo,
    x = 1967,
    y = 33,
    team = "UCLA",
    height = .065,
    alpha = 0.3
  ) +
  ggplot2::annotate(
    cfbplotR::GeomCFBlogo,
    x = 1995,
    y = 26,
    team = "Kentucky",
    height = .055,
    alpha = 0.3
  ) +
  ggplot2::annotate(
    cfbplotR::GeomCFBlogo,
    x = 2000.5,
    y = 28.5,
    team = "Duke",
    height = .055,
    alpha = 0.3
  ) +
  ggplot2::annotate(
    cfbplotR::GeomCFBlogo,
    x = 2010,
    y = 24.5,
    team = "Kansas",
    height = .055,
    alpha = 0.3
  ) +
  ggplot2::annotate(
    cfbplotR::GeomCFBlogo,
    x = 1975.5,
    y = 26,
    team = "Indiana",
    height = .055,
    alpha = 0.3
  ) +
    ggplot2::annotate(
    cfbplotR::GeomCFBlogo,
    x = 2027.5,
    y = 15,
    team = "North Carolina",
    height = .055,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title    = "Carolina basketball continues to strive for sustained consistency",
    subtitle = "Four-year rolling SRS (simple-rating-system) across 75+ major-conference programs since 1960. <br>North Carolina is highlighted in blue, logos for other programs with the highest all-time SRS, and  all others programs in gray.",
    x        = "",

      face = "bold",
      size = 14,
      family = "Roboto Condensed",
      margin = ggplot2::margin(b = 4)
    ),
    plot.subtitle = ggtext::element_markdown(

    ),
```
